candidates.summary: A lowercase 'word: text' prose line between an opening thematic break and a later one makes the block front matter, so everything between the two rules, a heading included, is cut from the served page
candidates.failure_scenario:
Static alias file '---

# Welcome

note: the testnet resets every week.

---

More text...
': line 49 admits 'note' as a front matter key (lowercase word, colon then space), line 52 skips '# Welcome' as a YAML comment, sawKey goes true and target.Value becomes only the text after the second rule. GET /about serves 200, index, follow, title 'about - gno.land' (the H1 is gone, so the title falls back to the path), with neither the heading nor the note. At the merge base main.go:393 stored a static file verbatim (AliasTarget{Value: string(content)}), so the whole page rendered. This is the class gfanton raised in threads 4145044203 and 4156217924; the narrowing since covers capitalised prose, URLs, mailto and headings alone, not a lowercase key-shaped line. Fix: take a block as front matter only when it sets a known key (title or description), or when no blank line follows the opening fence.

Base main.go:393 'aliases[parts[0]] = gnoweb.AliasTarget{Value: string(content), Kind: gnoweb.StaticMarkdown}'.
